title: Pure Ursarctic
summary: Ursarctic cards only, with generic staples; the Drytron crossover cards are left out. Every Mik and Mega monster summons itself on either Main Phase by tributing another Level 7 or higher monster from the hand. The Mik monsters then search, revive or summon another Ursarctic, and the Mega Tuners banish, destroy or flip a card. Ursarctic Departure searches two at once, and Big Dipper and Departure let you banish from the GY instead of tributing. Their Synchros are summoned by Level difference, not by Synchro Summon. A Tuner and a non-Tuner one Level apart make Polari or Polar Star, and a Level 8 Tuner plus a Level 1 Synchro make Septentrion or Grand Chariot. Polar Star, the newest, turns Septentrion into a lock on every Extra Deck monster with a Level. Ultimate Bright Knight Ursatron Alpha summons itself next to an Ursarctic and searches an Ursarctic Spell/Trap.

exclude.Ursarctic Drytron: Banishes Drytron Fafnir, which the pure list doesn't play.
exclude.Ultimate Flagship Ursatron: Only Ursarctic Drytron can summon it.
